reviews.title: Please Update!
reviews.text: This used to be my go-to app for Japanese. I loved all the features it had and I used lists for organizing words I had learned. Now the app won’t even load without crashing. Please update the app as I really loved it and I’m bummed I can’t use it anymore!

reviews.title: Speech function doesn’t work
reviews.text: Speech function just doesn’t work anymore. It used to sound robotic, but now, it gives a warning that it’ll sound robotic, but just doesn’t work; I even tried uninstalling and reinstalling again and it STILL doesn’t work. The other functions are great, but without the speech, it feels incomplete. I’ve contacted support and changed my live speech voice settings, and that didn’t help, so I can’t speak to if changing that improved the voice, because now I hear nothing.

reviews.title: Important First Hand Experience
reviews.text: I have used this app for years.  I go to Japan often, I have family there.  Now.  What happens is I say something, and they don’t know what it is.  I show them, but chigau(it’s not right).  This happened so many times that I have come to not trust the app.  I feel like I have wasted a lot of time learning the wrong things.
